ColdChain.title: From donor to <important>transfusion</important>.
ColdChain.description: One supplier for every stage a blood unit passes through in your blood bank.
ColdChain.donor_description: Screen donor hemoglobin, monitor collection and carry blood in cool boxes.
ColdChain.processing_description: Weigh, spin, separate and seal bags into blood components.
ColdChain.storage_description: Hold red cells, plasma and platelets at the right temperature.
ColdChain.crossmatch_description: Blood grouping and crossmatch with gel card systems and their reagents.

Trust.title: Always <important>there</important>.

Trust.fact2_description: Recorded per delivery and dispatched first-expiry, first-out.
Trust.fact3_description: Every transaction is recorded for medical device distribution audits.

Chat.title: PT Mitra Labora Medika assistant
Chat.greeting: Hi! Ask me about ordering, payment, installments, delivery or order tracking.
Chat.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
Chat.answer_order: Open the Catalog, pick a product and fill in the order form. No account is needed.
Chat.answer_track: Open Track order and enter your order code and the phone number you used when ordering.
Chat.answer_payment: After you order, pay online from the Track order page (bank transfer, e-wallet, QRIS) or wait for our team to send payment instructions. Your payment status shows on the Track order page.
Chat.answer_installment: At checkout you can choose to pay in full or in monthly installments. Each installment and its due date is shown on your order page.
Chat.answer_shipping: Orders are shipped after payment is confirmed. Follow the status (packed, shipped, delivered) on the Track order page.
Chat.answer_catalog: See all products and prices in the Catalog page.
Chat.answer_contact: Contact our team on WhatsApp: {whatsapp} or email {email}.
Chat.answer_fallback: I could not find an answer to that. Please contact our team on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}

FAQ.title: Common questions
FAQ.answer1: Prices come in a formal quote. Tap "Request a quote" on a product page to message us on WhatsApp.
FAQ.question2: Do the products have distribution permits?
FAQ.answer2: Yes. Every product we sell has a Ministry of Health distribution permit (AKD).
FAQ.answer3: Upfront transfer, invoice with payment terms, or installments, agreed in each quote.
FAQ.answer4: On WhatsApp {whatsapp}, by email at {email}, or through the chat assistant at the bottom right.
